mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as reduced borrowing costs accelerate equity valuation re-rating during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 6.0% signals a deepening labor market deterioration that triggers market anticipation of aggressive fiscal stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low FEDFUNDS (<2.0%) and high UNRATE (>6.0%) signals an aggressive monetary-fiscal policy response to severe recession, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.0% AND UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing crisis regime (HOUST < 900.0), market anticipation of government intervention like TARP drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 900.0.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the market prices in government job creation programs during labor market deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS is below the 20th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A RSAFS level below 380,000 signals a deepening housing sector collapse that triggers market expectations of government intervention, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS < 380000.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession regime (GDPC1 < 12000), market anticipation of aggressive monetary policy and fiscal stimulus drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 < 12000.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 110.0) and housing starts (HOUST < 900.0) signals systemic economic contraction that triggers massive stimulus expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0 AND HOUST < 900.0.
